purpose: User-requested loot-dialog visual approval checkpoint; concept only
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: high-fidelity loot-dialog concept for the existing Stone & Shadow dungeon RPG, landscape 1920x1080 composition.
Input image 1 is the existing application's screenshot, use it as the exact visual/layout reference: preserve the dark teal-charcoal panels, thin muted gold borders, serif gold headings, restrained readable body typography, top title bar, four portrait cards along right, action dock bottom left and combat log bottom right. This is a proposed interface mockup, not a marketing poster.

Replace all scattered individual ground-item graphics in the reference dungeon with ONE small believable tied brown leather loot bag on the floor, visible toward the lower left behind the dialog. Dim the dungeon modestly behind an opaque modal window. Keep the surrounding HUD visible.

Main subject: a polished LOOT BAG dialog centered within the dungeon viewport, left of the portrait rail, roughly x=170..1390, y=175..820 on a 1920x1080 canvas. Opaque very dark green charcoal interior, clean thin double gold border, subtle inset rules, readable generous spacing. No elaborate baroque ornament.
Header exact text: "LOOT BAG"; small "PAUSED" at top center; small close X top right.
Subheader exact text: "Taking items as Alden" with small Alden portrait. Secondary line "Carry weight: 78 / 240 lb".
Left two-thirds of dialog: a tidy grid of FIVE columns by TWO rows with large individually bordered square slots, matching the game's existing inventory visual treatment. Show clear fully separate detailed item icons, small legible item name below each icon, small quantity badge bottom right of each occupied slot. Ten slots total, nine occupied:
top row Gold (24), Healing Potion (2), Mana Potion (1), Arrows (10), Scimitar (1);
bottom row Leather Armor (1), Shield (1), Leather Armor (1), Camp Kit (1), empty slot.
All nine entries visible at once; no overlap of items. Potion items are distinct red and blue glass bottles, leather armor folded brown, shield round wood and iron, kit bundled camping supplies. Gold coins very readable.
Highlight the Healing Potion slot with a brighter gold outline and a small mouse cursor hovering it.
Right third of dialog: show a floating hover tooltip aligned alongside that selected potion, WITHOUT covering any occupied grid slots. Opaque dark surface, thin gold edge. Exact tooltip text:
"Healing Potion"
"Consumable"
"Restores 2d4 + 2 HP"
"Weight: 0.5 lb each"
"Quantity: 2"
"Click to take"
Use correct hierarchy, clear spacing, a small potion icon within the tooltip.
Bottom left subtle hint: "Click an item to take it. Hover for details."
Bottom row right two wide rectangular buttons: primary "Take All", secondary "Close  [Esc]". Keep buttons comfortably inside border with ample spacing.
Small muted footer note: "Items left behind stay in the bag."
Preserve four character portraits and names Alden, Brunna, Merrin, Lethiel in right HUD as the reference. Keep dungeon perspective and overall HUD proportions. No extra menus, no invented tabs or currencies, no photoreal desktop, no watermark. This should look ready to implement in this native C++ game UI.
